messages:
nina: Alerting - after tonight's egress prefix-list swap I'm seeing a surge of provisioning failures in us-west-3. Several GPU nodes stuck in Provisioning with 403s to the metadata-keystore proxy.
omar: confirm. Node log: `ERROR keystore: 403 Forbidden from https://metadata-keystore.internal/v1/session` - looks like outbound blocked by new prefix-list.
security-bot: Change: prefix-list-swap applied to vpc-prod-llm (by security-deploy). Replaced PL-INFRA-OLD -> PL-INFRA-NEW. Rollout: immediate.
rachel.sre: impact: warmpool in us-west-3 down ~42%, autoscaler trimming GPUs, p50 latency increasing. Fallback traffic hitting CPU pools and regional NAT egress rising.
nina: quick triage shows PL-INFRA-NEW does not include keystore subnet 10.60.5.0/24 nor KMS-proxy 10.60.6.0/24 - swap introduced a content drift.
omar: mitigation options: 1) rollback prefix-list swap 2) append missing CIDRs to PL-INFRA-NEW 3) create temporary per-subnet allow rules. Prefer to append missing CIDRs for minimal blast.
ops-bot: Change Request CR#4042 opened by omar: append keystore and kms-proxy CIDRs to PL-INFRA-NEW; canary to us-west-3a. Rollback: revert prefix-list contents to previous version.
security-bot: Prefix-list update applied: PL-INFRA-NEW appended 10.60.5.0/24,10.60.6.0/24. Change id pl-4042.
rachel.sre: smoke from previously stuck node: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://metadata-keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200. Two nodes reached Ready within 60s.
nina: metrics: failed launches dropped from 24% -> 1.8%, warmpool delta back to -6%.
omar: root cause: no validation of prefix-list contents during the swap. Action: create ENG-SEC-540 to add a preflight check that verifies managed prefix-lists include entries for the egress service registry. Assigning to nina.
ops-bot: Ticket ENG-SEC-540 created; owner nina.
rachel.sre: finance: please calculate cost delta for NAT egress and CPU fallback during the ~18m window. Early rough estimate ~1.2k USD.
security-bot: noted - retrospect entry appended to change record recommending canary guardrails for prefix-list swaps.
nina: short postmortem: outage ~18m, root cause: managed prefix-list content drift after swap. Remediation: prefix-list content checks in CI, update runbook to include mapping from services->CIDRs, and require a one-AZ canary for any global prefix-list replacement. Closing after ENG-SEC-540 kick-off. :thumbsup:
